boss:1:5a42971dd168bdf1.description: 僧侣 Boss · Prophet's Path。技能、等级和掉落按 Wiki 所列资料展示；出现条件另见来源备注。
details: 技能列表（英文）：Contemplation of Purity · Divine Intervention · Guardian · Mark of Protection · Reversal of Fortune

npc.title: Kepkhet Marrowfeast
npc.skillsText:
* Contemplation of Purity
* Divine Intervention
* Guardian
* Mark of Protection (elite)
* Reversal of Fortune
npc.notes:
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't pop up until a party member approaches her spawn point. 
*She is surrounded by several Scarab Nest Builders who use lots of traps. Melee characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range.
*Kepkhet can be pulled and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity which will remove Mark of Protection.
*Aurek the Scarab Hunter in Augury Rock (outpost) tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.

* Quickroot can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from Beacon's Perch. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. npc.notes:
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of Thunderhead Keep. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.

npc.notes:
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of Thunderhead Keep. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.

boss:1:aa9313472b0ea40c.description: 幻术师 Boss · The Hall of Heroes。技能、等级和掉落按 Wiki 所列资料展示；出现条件另见来源备注。
details: 技能列表（英文）：Backfire · Diversion · Energy Surge · Ignorance · Soothing Images · Fingers of Chaos

掉落列表（英文）：Elswyth's Longbow · Elswyth's Recurve Bow · Illyana's Mirror · Illyana's Staff · Kole's Gauntlet · Kole's Torment · Milius' Eye · Milius' Pillar · Ogre-Slaying Knife · Victo's Battle Axe · Victo's Blade · Victo's Bulwark · Victo's Maul · Wenslauss' Chalice · Wenslauss' Faith

npc.title: The Darkness (boss)
npc.areasText:
* Prophecies
** The Rift
*** The Hall of Heroes
npc.skillsText:
16 Domination Magic, 15 Illusion Magic
* Backfire
* Diversion
* Energy Surge (elite)
* Ignorance
* Soothing Images
* Fingers of Chaos
npc.notes:
* Strategy: After killing the two Chaos Wurms, head to the left side and kill the popups (there is no need to go to the right side (unless farming for ecto)). From the left side stairway, target the nearest Terrorweb Dryder and pull with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break aggro and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they cannot be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that solo farm the Tomb of the Primeval Kings.

* Tranquil Was Tanasen (elite)

npc.notes:
* Orosen will start running towards you when you reach the middle of the bridge (about twice the range of your aggro circle), followed by the rest of his group. This is useful because it can be used to pull him and his group onto the bridge where two Canthan Guards will engage him and they will be standing together so area of effect skills affect most of them, possibly making the fight easier.
** Even if you approach from the north, Orosen and his group runs to the Senji's Corner portal as soon as you enter compass range of their initial location. They start fighting the Canthan Guards around the portal when you get in compass range of their new location.
* It is highly advisable to pre-apply protection and keep your party spread out, because of Orosen's potentially high spike damage.

npc.notes:
* Whiteout resides at the top of a steep rise, on a narrow path. 
** Beware of tumbling boulders that can instantly kill anyone in their path. 
** If you are using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them at the bottom of the rise, the walk up the path to trigger the boulders so that you can more easily dodge them.
* Whiteout is accompanied by an Avalanche and two Ice Elementals, but is very vulnerable to fire damage.
** Focus everyone's attack on Whiteout and he will go down quickly. After killing him your party will be able to take out the rest of the enemies.
** To farm this boss, rezone at the nearby Frostmaw's Burrows dungeon portal.

npc.areasText:

* Power Attack

npc.notes:
* When close to the edge of the player's compass, Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His Devourer Siege can easily wipe out a party that is not spread out; flag heroes and henchmen around or underneath him and either interrupt or blind him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and Power Attack.
* You can tank Rocktail using the nearby Siege Devourer: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in hard mode.
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended aggro range, much like Kournan Spotters.
* Due to Devourer Siege, Pain Inverter is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.

details: 技能列表（英文）：Aura of Restoration · Fire Attunement · Flame Djinn's Haste · Glowing Gaze · Glyph of Lesser Energy · Mark of Rodgort · Searing Flames

npc.title: Borrguus Blisterbark
npc.areasText:
* Charr Homelands
** Sacnoth Valley
*** Burning forest
npc.skillsText:
* Aura of Restoration
* Fire Attunement
* Flame Djinn's Haste
* Glowing Gaze
* Glyph of Lesser Energy
* Mark of Rodgort
* Searing Flames (elite)
npc.notes:
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies. They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them. 
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Tease, or a ranger with Choking Gas. 
:* The interrupt Complicate, when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* Hex Eater Vortex and Shatter Hex can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as Guilt and Mistrust can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* Winter will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the spike damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing Frigid Armor to effectively prevent any damage from Searing Flames.

npc.notes:
* His route is approximately 5 minutes in length, varying in direction and path per spawn. It patrols around the edge of the northeastern lagoon more often than the south route.
* Flannuss usually becomes stuck on a cliff almost directly south of Vlox's Falls, at the northernmost tip of the land jutting into the river delta - marked with the monk icon on the wiki map. The quickest way to locate the boss should be to travel clockwise on the red path. Alternatively, wait in the spot where it may get stuck - both patrol routes overlap here.
* An easy (but repetitive) method for killing Flannuss is to zone into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls head forward, killing the first two groups of Krait and heading left along the cliff tops. If he is not there, he will likely be there in two minutes - otherwise he is on the other route, so rezone and try again.

npc.notes:
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some interrupt skills.
* Spoil Victor and Pain Inverter are very effective against Joffs. Enchantment removal will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the damage from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your party as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.

npc.notes:
* The Broodmother's cave is just south of the northern exit in Rata Sum. Not far from her spawn point, you can find a Jar of Invigoration; when dropped, it provides 30 energy to all nearby creatures.
* The cave is filled with three large groups of level 15 Raptor Nestlings. Although they deal relatively little damage, they spam Disrupting Stab, preventing your team from using skills effectively. Rekoff herself deals large amounts of damage. Bring a team that can deal effectively with significant amounts of melee and bring interruption counter-tactics.
* Since the cave is so close to Rata Sum, her group is used to farm Asura reputation points and festival trophy drops. The popularity of the farm also means that Claws of the Broodmother are very common and do not trade at a premium.

* Certain areas past the bridge around Rotscale periodically inflicts poison on party members and allies.
* You can pay for two buffs after summoning a Champion of Balthazar at the statue of Balthazar near the bridge to Rotscale:

Killing both the Mantid Drones will cause another three mantids to popup - a Mantid Monitor, a Mantid Drone, and either Yunlai Deathkeeper or a Mantid Darkwing.
* As noted above, this boss may or may not spawn. If it does not spawn, a level 6 Mantid Darkwing will spawn instead, so just map travel back to the Minister Cho's Estate oupost and make the journey again until Yunlai spawns.
* Yunlai will always spawn if you adhere strictly to the following approach. When entering the temple and before killing any mantids, go immediately to the left chamber. There you will find a Mantid Monitor: kill it. Next, kill the two Mantid Drone Hatchlings. Two Mantid Drones will popup: kill them, and two Mantid Drones and Yunlai will popup. Killing any other mantid other than the ones mentioned, may prevent Yunlai from appearing.

Wiki 所列掉落（英文）：Granite Slab · Sentient Lodestone

npc.title: The Drought
npc.skillsText:
20 Earth Magic
* Ebon Hawk
* Sandstorm (elite)
* Stone Daggers
* Stoning
npc.notes:
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of Abaddon; Lightbringer's Gaze is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** Winter will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be shutdown by daze, Power Block or knock downs. 
** Pain Inverter is even more effective using a minion master to exploit Sandstorm's area of effect damage — the more minions that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** Protective Spirit is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** Shelter provides enough party-wide protection to kill the Drought using the Pain Inverter strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).

npc.notes:
* To make the fight easier draw him away from his spawn point towards the City of Torc'qua. Putting your casters behind the fortress wall will allow them to cast spells in relative safety (Jadoth and his ranged allies will be unable to hit them).
** Alternatively there is a cliff on the other side of the fortress. Hiding your casters beneath that cliff will yield similar results.
* Jadoth's group has two monks, make sure to take enough anti-healing skills.
* He is very powerful and will make short work of parties approaching him when allowing him to cast his Storm of Judgment too often. Soothing Images and Diversion are effective counters.
* A Spirit of Truth will spawn near to the reward Chest after his death.
* To get the Torc'qua Chest, all Margonites must be killed. You may find that a couple hide beyond the hill towards The Stygian Veil. Approaching this area will cause them to come toward you.

details:
物品说明（英文）：A Charr Bag is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they cannot be upgraded by using a Rune of Holding. A Superior Rune of Holding can be applied to it after leaving Pre-Searing and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to storage, have little inventory space.

** The Northlands

***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy

***Elementalist Jaw Smokeskin
* Depths of Tyria
** Forsaken Tunnels
***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge
***Elementalist Maz Scourgeheart
***Maz's Chest

Wiki 备注（英文）：* Charr Bags use the same inventory icon as Jun's Art Supplies, Tasca's Pack, and Zehtuka's Pack.
* They appear to have the same model as the backpacks carried by some Merchants.
* This item cannot be dyed.
* Empty bags can be moved into other, equipped bags, or into your storage, but as with any other container, they cannot be unequipped until you remove all items.

details: 物品说明（英文）：A Charr Salvage Kit is a type of kit that provides the only method for pre-Searing characters to obtain upgrade components. They look and work the same as Expert Salvage Kits; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as drops from one of the Charr bosses or Maz's Chest.

获取方式（英文）：* Ascalon (pre-Searing)
** The Northlands
***Warrior Scarl the Slicer
***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy
***Mesmer Ghast Ashpyre

* Depths of Tyria

***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge

Wiki 备注（英文）：* This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in pre-Searing Ascalon, including weapon upgrades, Runes, or Insignias. With the introduction of The Purveyor players are able to obtain the Infinite Superior Salvage Kit in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the Wisdom title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a merchant).
* These kits can be used to salvage rare crafting materials, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the Wisdom and Treasure Hunter bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.

获取方式（英文）：* Eye of the North
** The Throwdown in a Norn Town quest

Wiki 备注（英文）：See: Dwarven brawling#Recommended equipment
* If doing Dwarven brawling only, for best results, apply the following modifications to increase the damage substantially (along with other benefits):
** Inscription: Brawn over Brains (+15% damage; the -5 energy is irrelevant, since the loss of energy is negated by Dwarven Brawling).
** Dagger Tang: Vampiric (minor healing while fighting), Sundering (extra damage), or Furious (faster adrenaline build).
** Dagger Handle: of Shelter (of Defense is almost as useful)
** Customization (if not sharing between characters).

* If you do not meet the required rank of 9 in Dagger Mastery, these will do 1-3 dmg, less than the default Brass Knuckles.
* You can use an identification kit on this item, but it will have no effect.

details: 物品说明（英文）：The Hammer of Kathandrax, also called Kathandrax's Crusher, is the required quest item for completing Kathandrax's Crusher. It drops from the Chest of Kathandrax, the dungeon reward chest at the end of the Catacombs of Kathandrax.

Wiki 备注（英文）：* Despite its name and look, this is not a weapon.
* If you have this quest item, you do not need to enter the catacombs to gain credit for completing Kathandrax's Crusher. This has created a demand from Survivor candidates interested in risk-free experience points.
** You would need 179 hammers to earn the 1,337,500 XP required to maximize a character's rank in the Survivor title track.
* You still need to complete the dungeon to get credit for the Ilsundur, Lord of Fire (Zaishen quest) and the Master Dungeon Guide.
A stack of two or more Hammers of Kathandrax appears singular in its description, e.g. "2 Hammer of Kathandrax".

物品说明（英文）：This sword shares a similar shape with the Violet Edge and Emerald Edge. Three things distinguish these oddly shaped swords from one another; the first and most noticeable is the color. The Violet Edge is purple in color, the Emerald Edge is green, and the Cerulean Edge is a light blue. Secondly, the small golden orb located above the grip in the first curve of the blade is held in place by braces; on the Violet Edge, one brace holds it in place, on the Emerald, two settings hold it, and on the Cerulean Edge, three braces securely fasten it. Lastly, the three Edges differ slightly in size, with the Violet being the smallest, the Emerald being slightly longer, and the Cerulean being the largest.

获取方式（英文）：;Eye Of The North
*Depths of Tyria
**Ooze Pit
***Prismatic Chest

stories.title: 预言 · Prophecies
stories.introduction: 由阿斯卡隆的毁灭出发，追查白斗篷、马赛特与寻火者预言。其他篇章的角色从狮子拱门一段加入主线。

arcs.title: 阿斯卡隆与流亡
arcs.text: 毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在夏尔入侵中组织抵抗，随后率难民越过席娃山脉；他在霜门的撤离途中牺牲。

arcs.title: 白斗篷的秘密
arcs.text: 抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向时，他们发现白斗篷献祭无辜者，转而与光刃并肩作战；马基斯的背叛迫使众人撤离。

arcs.title: 水晶沙漠的飞升
arcs.text: 在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙格琳特的巢穴。格琳特揭示白斗篷主人是马赛特，并解释寻火者预言。
arcs.note: 前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这里并非三条互斥分支。

arcs.title: 南席娃山脉的反攻
arcs.text: 英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，随后帮助矮人夺回雷云要塞。

arcs.title: 火环群岛的背叛
arcs.text: 基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露巫妖身份，试图借欧尔权杖控制泰坦。英雄最终击败巫妖，再次封闭大门。

arcs.title: 尾声
arcs.text: 主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方的泰坦首领。这是后续任务，不能与最终主线任务混为一项。
arcs.note: 预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任务都是通关必做条件。

stories.title: 盟与敌 · Factions
stories.introduction: 瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色由星岬寺开始；其他篇章角色从北方码头进入凯宁城的剧情。

arcs.title: 星岬岛的瘟疫
arcs.text: 东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的标记，随后赴凯宁城求援。

arcs.title: 成为仰望星辰者
arcs.text: 英雄在薇茹广场被白影杀死，又由使者复活。为对抗灵魂与白影，他们完成纳普区的试炼，成为 Weh no Su，并在谭纳凯神殿释放古代英雄。

arcs.title: 两件圣物
arcs.text: 英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关闭裂隙，却得知圣物只能暂时阻止白影。

arcs.title: 库兹柯或勒克森路线
arcs.text: 英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的幼龟。面对共同的瘟疫威胁，两方形成合作，故事在沉睡之水重新汇合。
arcs.note: 永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两条阵营路线。

arcs.title: 皇宫决战
arcs.text: 英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝牺牲，白影借皇族之血重返人间；英雄随后在帝国圣所击败他。

stories.title: 黑暗逆袭 · Nightfall
stories.introduction: 伊洛那日戟军对抗瓦蕾丝与阿巴顿的势力。伊洛那角色从伊斯坦训练开始；外来角色通过 Battle Preparations 等任务加入，随后衔接领事馆码头。

arcs.title: 伊斯坦的调查
arcs.text: 日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶特与海盗合作，并得知瓦蕾丝试图释放阿巴顿。
arcs.note: 三项任务分别要求 Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora 随队。

arcs.title: 科瑞纳的败退与反攻
arcs.text: 日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过科瑞纳进入瓦比；一段任务取决于选择玛格丽特或密语大师。
arcs.note: Pogahn Passage 与 Rilohn Refuge 是替代路线，分别要求 Margrid the Sly 与 Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks 和 Moddok Crevice 要求 Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery 要求 Koss；Kodonur Crossroads 要求 Zhed Shadowhoof。

arcs.title: 瓦比的两处分歧
arcs.text: 瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎诺要塞路线；之后可选择救援罗鳩村，或夺回瑟伯欣花园。
arcs.note: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion 二选一；Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay 也只需一项继续主线，后两者并非永久互斥。分别检查 Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni 的随队要求；Grand Court of Sebelkeh 要求 Tahlkora。

arcs.title: 穿越硫磺荒原
arcs.text: 英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，并在摩拉废墟击败瓦蕾丝；此时黑暗逆袭已经侵入现实。
arcs.note: 分别要求 Zhed Shadowhoof 与 General Morgahn 随队。

arcs.title: 折磨领域与新神
arcs.text: 英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫妖与白影。阿巴顿被击败后，逸散的力量威胁整个领域；寇米尔承接这股力量，成为掌管真相、知识与秘密的新神。

stories.title: 北方之眼 · Eye of the North
stories.introduction: 地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联合阿苏拉、诺恩和黑檀先锋队，对抗大毁灭者。

arcs.title: 第一幕：末日的开端
arcs.text: 角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并抵达北方之眼，与关及黑檀先锋队会合。

arcs.title: 阿苏拉盟友
arcs.text: 英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用魔像突袭毁灭者巢穴。

arcs.title: 失踪的先锋队
arcs.text: 关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士皮雷合作，最终突袭要塞并解救兰玛队长等人。

arcs.title: 北方盟友
arcs.text: 英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地，赢得诺恩的支持。
arcs.note: 第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，最终需要全部完成；诺恩线中的后两条任务也有并列前置关系。

arcs.title: 第三幕：群山深处
arcs.text: 盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪式，让多数矮人化为石矮人。联军深入中央传送室，击败大毁灭者，瓦解毁灭者的协同行动。
